entities.name: Abdul Salam Azimi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdul Salam Azimi was an Afghan judge who was the Chief Justice of Afghanistan and, as such, the head of the Supreme Court of Afghanistan from August 2006 to October 2014, when he resigned his position.
